== Virtual Set P release waves (issue 379) ==

The parent set is now divided into the 24 February 2017 and 30 August 2019 release waves, using stable parent-page anchors rather than separate short articles. The source matrix counts four and three original card designs, with each Objective counted once. All eleven inherited presentation rows are retained and regrouped, including alternate images and both Objective faces. Original-state card articles are linked separately from current card articles. The old total of ten was a catalog/presentation count, not the seven original wave designs. Your Ship? and the navigation chart are separate additional material; the 31 May 2019 addendum predates the memorial wave and is not assigned a first-release date from its text stamp. The chart’s first release and alternate-image release dates remain undated. The supplied December 2022 PDF establishes the named group’s membership, not its original 2019 game text. Captain Khurgee’s nonexistent (V) (Errata) target was repaired to the existing original/current (V) article; the other inherited changes were card-link substitutions only and were preserved.
